== Description ==

[[Timo Dusel]] (left, blue Outrider Cup 2021 hoodie) and [[Casey Anis]] (right) at the ''[[Star Wars: Unlimited]]'' Sector Qualifier at Eisbach Studios, Munich, Germany, 1–2 November 2025. Both played the 512-player main event, Dusel as dillen (105th) and Anis as spideyguy0 (419th).
